purpose: Frozen symbolic Battle Map V3 blueprint authoring instructions for isolated Codex candidate workers.

variantBriefs.a: Emphasize a curved route network with two internally vertex-disjoint formation-to-formation crossings, asymmetric formation clearings, and independently routed natural-slope and stair approaches to any overlook that requires both.
variantBriefs.b: Emphasize broad terraces, readable elevation changes, and a secondary lateral staging area.
variantBriefs.c: Emphasize a biome-owned landmark, flanking route, and irregular rendered silhouette without reducing spawn access.

prompt: Author exactly one symbolic TemplateMapBlueprint JSON object. Treat the approved source image only as a compositional and style reference. The reviewed source sidecar is the gameplay authority. Use only the closed keys and symbolic values described by the attached contract; do not provide runtime URLs, hashes, movement costs, executable content, Markdown, validation claims, or prose outside the JSON document. The result must be 32 by 32, use an irregular render mask and a playable mask contained by it, preserve all required semantic areas, include biome-owned routes/boundaries/features, provide five ordered player slots, exactly the approved opposing candidate-pool capacity with diverse tactical-role tags, and support the approved maximum simultaneous opponents. Every spawn must be playable, passable after compilation, locally clear, mutually reachable, and connected through the required number of independent approaches. Integer elevation levels must obey the sidecar range. Every traversable elevation change must be declared as a cardinal slope or stair; larger changes must be blocked cliffs. Each obstacle record using the fixed landmark family represents exactly one one-tile collision footprint, and its anchor must be that same cell; repeat the family in separate uniquely identified records to form a larger visual cluster. Expected asset families must remain the exact fixed set in completeShapeExample.expectedAssetFamilies. Every symbolic family reference in the candidate must use that fixed set; do not replace it with content-specific family names.
negativeConstraints: literal image tracing or pixel-derived coordinates
full-width or full-height cleared spawn strips
rectangular arena walls or repeated straight boundaries
detached spawn pads or a formation with one choke point
player slots or opponent candidates placed on exits or inside any approach region
formation-clearing regions that contain cells beyond their exact side's spawn cells, omit a spawn cell, or serve both sides
a player or opponent formation whose inclusive bounding-box width or height exceeds half the map dimension rounded up
disconnected required route centerlines when the reviewed intent calls for interlocking loops or a figure-eight; annotations do not create route connectivity
interlocking or figure-eight routes whose explicit ordered centerlines share one articulation cell or edge; two nearby route surfaces do not replace two internally vertex-disjoint crossings
an elevated approach that substitutes two stairs on one route for the separately routed natural-slope and stair portals required by the reviewed topology
unexplained one-cell peaks or undeclared elevation edges
checkerboard materials or ambiguous movement surfaces
multi-cell obstacle records or obstacle anchors outside their one-tile collision cell
runtime asset paths, content hashes, movement costs, or database fields
filesystem traversal, symbolic links, or writes outside candidate.json and last-message.txt
approval records, compiled maps, catalogs, runtime assets, or edits to tracked project content
Markdown fences, comments, executable code, or prose outside the JSON object
